                } catch (final IOException e) {

        FastReader scn = new FastReader();

        arr = new int[n];

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {

            return;

            else oddCount++;

                map.put(i, Math.abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]));
            }
        }

        } else {

            Collections.sort(list);
            int count = 0;

                if (val <= b) {
                    b -= val;

            }
            System.out.print(count);
